snippet.title: RELEASE DATE ANNOUNCEMENT - Aperture Dating Simulator
snippet.description:
NOTE: The voice actor for ??? in this video, Jeremy Retamar Arietta, no longer works with us.

It's finally here! Aperture Dating Simulator is proud to announce our official release date!

If everything goes right and nothing goes wrong, APDS will release on August 28th of this year on Steam. We know this seems rather soon, but trust us! We're well on the way to being completely done.

Join our Discord or subscribe to stay updated, and wishlist us on the Steam Store!

Discord: https://discord.gg/GedmcRdXBj
_____________________________
edited by Ashleyanna Rivers
music by Dylan Turner
